title: Enhancing Mathematical Problem Solving in LLMs through Execution-Driven Reasoning Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating mathematical reasoning accuracy on problem-solving benchmarks (MATH, AIME, GSM8K) using ablation studies to measure the impact of a dual-branch architecture, which mitigates the model's over-reliance on (or bias toward) potentially flawed programmatic context and execution signals.
